name: Boston v2.0 multicentre tissue cohort
recruitment_context: Symptomatic referral patients with MRI and tissue
pathology_availability: Biopsy, hematoma evacuation, or autopsy; full-autopsy subset
known_reuse: Derivation, temporal, geographic, and full-autopsy analyses within one publication
bias_relevance: Tissue verification and referral spectrum can inflate transportability
independence_notes: Validation subsets are separated but arise from the same coordinated study program

name: ROSMAP
recruitment_context: Religious Orders Study and Rush Memory and Aging Project
imaging: Ante-mortem and ex-vivo imaging in subsets
known_reuse: Boston transportability, ARTS development, arteriolosclerosis, cognition, and mixed-pathology studies
bias_relevance: Volunteer, highly educated, older cohort; repeated reuse is not independent replication
independence_notes: Publications may use overlapping participants and differently filtered subsets

name: Mayo nonhemorrhagic MRI-autopsy cohort
bias_relevance: Small selected pathology subset and nonhemorrhagic spectrum
independence_notes: Independent setting from Boston derivation but modest sample

name: Mild Stroke Study 3
imaging: 3T structural, quantitative SVD, and carbon-dioxide CVR MRI
bias_relevance: Stroke enrichment limits generalization to community aging and specific vessel pathology
independence_notes: Analyses using the same cohort should not be counted as independent replication

name: MarkVCID multisite consortium
recruitment_context: Older adults across participating US sites
pathology_availability: Variable; not the reference for most instrumental studies
known_reuse: PSMD, free water, CVR, clinical and fluid protocols
bias_relevance: Heterogeneous sites improve transportability but outcomes often remain associative
independence_notes: Sites may be analyzed independently, but consortium-wide papers share infrastructure and some participants

name: ADNI
bias_relevance: AD-focused selection and exclusions limit arteriolosclerosis generalization
independence_notes: May be external to ROSMAP development but not representative clinical care

name: Edinburgh lobar ICH pathology cohort
bias_relevance: Applies to lobar ICH, not cognitive or asymptomatic presentations
independence_notes: Distinct context from MRI-based Boston criteria

name: Specialist CAA-ri comparative cohort
recruitment_context: CAA-ri and non-inflammatory CAA specialty care
bias_relevance: Referral enrichment and incorporation of imaging into diagnosis
independence_notes: Useful comparative phenotype evidence; not population accuracy

name: International postmortem CAA protocol network
known_reuse: Consensus protocol development, appraisal, and validation
bias_relevance: Consensus improves comparability but does not eliminate sampling error
independence_notes: Method paper rather than participant-outcome cohort

name: Hereditary CAA family cohorts
imaging: Serial research/clinical imaging in some cohorts
known_reuse: Natural history, risk factors, and mechanistic staging
bias_relevance: Founder effects, mutation specificity, younger age, and limited numbers
independence_notes: Different mutations should not be pooled without biological justification
